summary: Cold call by Meera to Vedant (>130 store chain). Vedant explained software was developed internally and referred rep to business head Mr Rishabh on professional network, but requested his own name not be mentioned.

evidence.label: Internal system in place
evidence.quote: We have developed our own software internally, so at present we aren't looking for anything outside the organisation.

evidence.label: Referral to business head
evidence.quote: If you want to speak to somebody about it, you can find our business head, Mr Rishabh, on a professional networking site.

evidence.label: Name usage constraint
evidence.quote: No, please don't use my name.

not_established: Whether Mr Rishabh has identified gaps in the internal software or is open to external vendors.

next_step.action: Conduct outreach to Mr Rishabh without referencing Vedant.
